newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-KEMPES TO COACH ALBANIAN CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KEMPES TO COACH ALBANIAN CLUB.

text.p: Mario Kempes, whose goals helped Argentina to their 1978 World Cup triumph, is to be the new coach of Albanian first division Lushnja, club officials said on Wednesday.
Lushnja president Pellumb Xhaferri said at Rinasi international airport that Kempes had agreed to a two-year contract with the club worth $300,000, which has yet to be signed.
Kempes said shortly after landing in Albania: "I don't know much about the team. However, looking at the present players it should all work out okay. But let's wait and see."

Lushnja are a poor 10th place in the league, despite signing three foreign players earlier in the year -- Brazilians Carlos Eduardo Castro de Souza -- nicknamed "Edu" -- and Vlademir Souza dos Santos, as well as Leonardo Ineh Nosa of Nigeria.
